syncSegmentsEn.text: The Lord’s love is like a river
Power flows from the throne to all peoples
He is the light that shines on my life
Worship the Lord and lift up His holy name
The Spirit of the Lord blows through my heart like the wind
Comforting the sorrowful and broken spirit
He is the King who reigns over my heart
Dear Lord, come down from heaven
A river flows and keeps on flowing
Flowing into fullness of life
Bless His wondrous, glorious, holy name
My spirit sings and keeps on singing
Until my spirit overflows with joy
Spirit of the Lord, come now to reign and move among us
